4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: ROLLER mod v2 pushed to your repo by Sunday night: 1 bug report + 1 feature request filed as GitHub Issues on your partner's repo, your own bug fixed and your partner's feature request built (or scoped down with a written reason), both signed off by your partner, and a v1 → v2 changelog on your portfolio site.
4th Period.workingNow: Playtesting your partner's ROLLER mod like a real QA tester, then filing 1 bug report and 1 feature request as Issues on their repo.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can file 2 GitHub Issues on my partner's repo — 1 bug with steps to reproduce and 1 feature request with a success test — so they could act on each one without asking me a single question.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.15 — Seek and incorporate feedback from team members and users to refine a solution that meets user needs.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.2 — Interacting with others in written English in various communicative forms.
agenda: Mini-lesson: What is QA? Bug vs. feature request (8 min)
I do: file both Issues on a sample mod (6 min)
Pair playtest: swap testers halfway (20 min)
You do: file your 2 Issues on their repo (8 min)
Exit Ticket: paste both Issue links (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Friday you played each other's MVPs and gave one thing to fix. Today that feedback goes professional: you are the QA tester, and you file it where real studios do — as GitHub Issues on the creator's repo, one broken thing and one wished-for thing. Tomorrow you switch sides and fix the bug someone filed on you.

6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Your finished game, published and embedded on your Google Site by Sunday night — with 1 bug report you wrote for a partner, 1 bug you fixed in your own game, and 3 sentences on what you changed and why.
6th Period.workingNow: Playing your partner's game like a game tester and writing up 1 bug so clearly they can fix it.
6th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can play my partner's game for 10 minutes and write 1 bug report so clear they can fix it without asking me anything.

6th Period.connections: Last week you built your game piece by piece, and Friday you played each other's. Today you become a game tester — the job that makes games better before anyone buys them.
